note: BackgroundBenefit desc: "Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma" — matches transformBackgrounds()'s BACKGROUND_TABLE.acolyte.abilityScores. 2024 rule: +2 to one of the three and +1 to a different one, OR +1 to each of the three. PickSchema's `abilities` variant can express only ONE `improve` grammar per choice (no either/or) and has no `from` list to restrict which abilities qualify, so this picks the dominant '+2/+1' form (the '+1/+1/+1' alternative isn't offered by this specific choice) and does not restrict the selection to {int, wis, cha} specifically — both are schema limitations, not modeling choices.
